primary_result: The frozen 625-scene measurement could not be interpreted because only 407 independent scenes completed all three variants. The other 218 scenes failed before a complete scene estimate when long-edge-320 resizing made the short edge too small for an internal official ConvIR-B reflection pad. The required complete-scene coverage gate therefore failed and no PASS or FAIL conclusion about tau-aligned local mismatch is authorized.
gate_reasons: Parent closeout, 625-scene list, selected OTS variants, official checkpoint, model source, and paired depth identities all matched.
The protected-data-free GPU contract strictly loaded the official checkpoint and passed the exact production forward and result-finalizer checks.
Only 407/625 independent scenes and 1,221/1,875 nested variants completed; 218 scenes failed with the same internal reflection-padding size condition after the frozen resize.

The diagnostic complete-case mismatch estimate was 22/625 under the predeclared missing-as-failure denominator, but it is not a valid scientific terminal because the complete-scene coverage and global-competence prerequisites were not met.
The typed terminal therefore authorizes only one measurement supplement with unchanged population, model, variants, estimand, margins, controls, and evidence role.
competing_explanation: The incomplete result cannot distinguish absence of tau-aligned mismatch from bias induced by aspect-ratio-dependent scene failure. A valid supplement must remove only that deterministic preprocessing incompatibility and recompute all 625 scenes consistently; it must not reuse only the favorable or completed subset.
limitations: This is an incomplete L1 development-screening measurement, not evidence for or against a candidate mechanism.
The 407 completed scenes cannot replace the frozen 625-scene population because completion depended on image aspect ratio after resizing.
No training, module selection, SOTS, Haze4K outcome, NH-HAZE, confirmation, canary, or locked-test data were accessed.
The only authorized next action is a preprocessing-only measurement supplement; thresholds and scientific definitions remain frozen.
